worldcombat.skill.rototiller.summary: Tills the chosen ground: while the turned soil stands, Grass-type Pokemon standing on it with their feet on the ground gain Attack and Sp. Atk together; airborne, stepping off the patch, or the soil reverting takes the boost back.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.use.0: Turn the soil under your Grass allies so they grow stronger together
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.use.1: Till a patch at the fight's position and make foes go around it
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.use.2: Leave airborne Grass types a patch they cannot touch
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.description: Turns a patch of soil of radius %1$s blocks that lasts %2$s.
Grass types on the soil gain %1$s stage of Attack and Sp. Atk; one till throws about %2$s clods.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.ridge.on: Ridge: a wider, longer patch, +1 more stage on both stats, at +3 ticks telegraph and x1.15 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.ridge.off: Quick till: a smaller, shorter patch with the base boost, cheaper in both telegraph and cooldown - till and move.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.timing: Ground-targeted move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.growth.0: From level %1$s: soil lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.rototiller.growth.1: From level %1$s: soil lasts %2$s, cooldown %3$s s.
Ridge: radius x1.3, duration x1.25, +1 more stage on both stats, at +3 ticks telegraph and x1.15 cooldown - prepare the ground first. Quick till: smaller, shorter, base boost, cheaper in telegraph and cooldown - till as you fight.
Consider tilling only while a Grass ally is this close; smaller stays local, larger walks over.
